    Generate SSM Fit Plot Including Auxiliary Variables

    plot_state_space_fit.Rd

    Constructs a two-panel stacked dashboard using ggplot2 and patchwork to visualize state-space model fits. The top panel displays primary measurement variables and trend components (with optional zero lower bound shading), while the bottom panel tracks cyclical deviations and auxiliary regressors.

    plot_state_space_fit(
  plot_df,
  title,
  subtitle,
  top_metrics,
  bottom_metrics,
  top_colors,
  bottom_colors,
  zlb_bounds = NULL,
  y_label_top = "Rate (%)",
  y_label_bottom = "Deviation / Rate (%)",
  save_path = NULL
)

    Arguments

    plot_df

    A data frame containing a date column (of class Date or yearqtr) alongside numeric metric series to plot.

    title

    Character. Main chart title for the top panel.

    subtitle

    Character. Chart subtitle for the top panel.

    top_metrics

    A named character vector mapping column names in plot_df to their corresponding legend labels for the top panel, formatted as c("column_name" = "Legend Label").

    bottom_metrics

    A named character vector mapping column names in plot_df to their corresponding legend labels for the bottom panel, formatted as c("column_name" = "Legend Label").

    top_colors

    A named character vector of color hex codes or names matching the legend label values defined in top_metrics.

    bottom_colors

    A named character vector of color hex codes or names matching the legend label values defined in bottom_metrics.

    zlb_bounds

    Optional numeric vector of length 2: c(ymin, ymax). Shades a horizontal band with threshold lines on the top plot (e.g., c(-0.75, 0.00)). Defaults to NULL.

    y_label_top

    Character. Y-axis label for the top panel. Defaults to "Rate (%)".

    y_label_bottom

    Character. Y-axis label for the bottom panel. Defaults to "Deviation / Rate (%)".

    save_path

    Optional character string. File path where the plot should be exported via ggplot2::ggsave. Directories are created automatically if they do not exist. Defaults to NULL.

    Value

    A combined patchwork object containing the two stacked ggplot panels.
